instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problems.

atoms.a: A drink is 500ml and has 3 ingredients: 200ml of milk, 146ml of coffee, and 154ml of melted chocolate. What percentage of the drink is not coffee?
atoms.sound: A drink is 500 millilitres and has 3 ingredients: 200 millilitres of milk, 146 millilitres of coffee, and 154 millilitres of melted chocolate. What percentage of the drink is not coffee?
atoms.b: ((++70.8% 70% 68.9%)) of the drink is not coffee.

atoms.a: An extra 100ml of coffee is added to the drink to make it stronger. Work out the new percentage of coffee in the drink.
atoms.sound: An extra 100 millilitres of coffee is added to the drink to make it stronger. Work out the new percentage of coffee in the drink.

hint.text: Remember, the total volume of the drink has changed too.

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problems.

atoms.a: A smoothie contains 50g of raspberries, 150g of orange, 90g of mango and 10g of strawberries. What percentage of the smoothie is made from berries?
atoms.sound: A smoothie contains 50 grams of raspberries, 150 grams of orange, 90 grams of mango and 10 grams of strawberries. What percentage of the smoothie is made from berries?
atoms.b: ((25% ++20% 30%)) of the smoothie is made from berries.

atoms.a: The smoothie was 300ml but after Polly’s lunch there is only 135ml of the smoothie left. What percentage of the smoothie is left?
atoms.sound: The smoothie was 300 millilitres but after Polly’s lunch there is only 135ml of the smoothie left. What percentage of the smoothie is left?
atoms.b: There is ((42% ++45% 40%)) of the smoothie left.
